groups.problem: The Lithuanian login and account TOTP instructions were replaced with the same Italian sentence.
groups.rationale: All three report the same wrong-language replacement repeated in two bundles. Each affected entry needs the corresponding Lithuanian text.

groups.problem: The account and admin JavaScript bundles replace i18next-compatible interpolation with unsupported Java MessageFormat syntax.
groups.rationale: All four describe the same formatting-contract mistake applied to the same message in two JS bundles. Restoring compatible message syntax in each bundle addresses these reports.

groups.problem: Independent common-prefix and common-suffix scans can overlap, causing invalid substring bounds when reporting sanitizer differences.
groups.rationale: These suggestions identify the same unbounded trimming logic and resulting exception. Their different examples and proposed clamps address the same problem.
